description.value: A family-oriented private campground directly on Skaha Lake at Penticton's south entrance off Highway 97, offering waterfront tent sites, a private sandy beach, and a heated outdoor pool; expect crowds in peak summer and note that advance reservations require week-long minimum stays.

address.value: 4200 Skaha Lake Road, Penticton, BC V2A 0K4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wright's Beach Camp is a seasonal family campground on Skaha Lake in Penticton, open roughly March–October. The services list explicitly mentions coin-operated showers, two laundromats, free wireless internet, a convenience store, and full hook-up sites with 30 amp power/water/sewer. Multiple pages confirm online reservation requests are accepted, with detailed reservation policies for 2026–2027 seasons. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, e-bike charging, or cycling tools/pumps. Address, phone, and email are confirmed on the contact page.
concerns: Seasonal operation only: closes mid-October, reopens early March. Early- and late-season touring cyclists should confirm availability.
OSM record lacks address and phone; values populated from website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active family campground with tenting sites on Skaha Lake in Penticton, directly along the Okanagan cycling corridor. Offers showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, and a convenience store — strong fit for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Also operates South Beach Gardens (www.southbeachgardens.com), described as another quiet family campground at a public beach nearby.

wow_evidence: coin-operated showers, two laundromats, free wireless internet, a convenience store
